newsitem.title: USA: Dow posts second biggest loss ever.
newsitem.headline: Dow posts second biggest loss ever.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average posted its second-biggest loss ever on Friday after an earnings warning by consumer products giant Gillette Co. and another drop in the dollar sent investors to the exit door.
Based on early and unofficial data, the blue-chip Dow closed down 247.37 points, or 3.11 percent, at 7,694.66. It was the steepest fall since a plunge of 508 points on Oct. 19, 1987.
In the broader market, declining issues swamped advances 3-1 on active volume of 538 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
Adding to the day's volatility was the "double-witching" expiration of both stock and index options.
Gillette shook Wall Street after it told analysts to lower their earnings estimates for the year. Its stock fell 4-5/16 at 85-7/8 in active trading.
In the bond market, the yield on the benchmark 30-year Treasury bond hovered at Thursday's close of 6.55 percent.
